Eligibility of Tenderer : Eligibility of Tenderer: Tenderer should be competent in term of legal, financial and technical capacity. Tenderer must fulfill the
requirements as set forth in the Tender Data Sheet (TDS) of the Tender Documents and the under mentioned requirements;
(a) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be minimum 10 (Ten) years.
(b) The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in construction works of
at least 01 (One) Number contract(s) of Construction of Road successfully completed within the last 05 (Five) years with a value of
at least TK.6(Six) Crore Only.
(c) The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than or equal to TK.20 (Twenty) Crore over the last 05
(Five) years. Average annual construction turnover would be calculated considering best 03 (Three) years over the last 05 (Five)
years.
(d) The minimum amount of liquid assets i.e working capital or credit line(s) of the Tenderers shall be as TK.3.00 (Three ) Crore
only.
(e) The minimum amount of Tender capacity shall be as TK.6.50 (Six point five) Crore Only.
(f) If the Tenderer's quoted price 10% above or 10% less than the official cost estimate, then Tender/Temder's will treated as Non
responsive.
